caption: The drawing features a central figure outlined in black, wearing a long garment with a red upper section and a black lower section decorated with white wave-like patterns. The garment is further detailed with beige vertical lines, and the bottom hem has a red decorative band. The figure has a halo behind its dark-haired head, and holds two objects: a green palm branch and a black staff resembling a trident or pitchfork. To the upper right of the main figure is a smaller figure with a pink robe and golden hair, surrounded by a yellow starburst shape; this figure is holding a small, round object. A red cross appears to the right of the central figure. The background includes light brown and blue areas, with a sky suggested by two blue sections behind the halos. The entire scene is bordered by a wavy black outline within a rectangular frame filled with a beige wash.
title: Plate 40: St. John Nepomuk: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
